svg.title: openmeet-core: Settings - audio, screen, privacy, general, profile, integrity (settings.rs)

g.text: openmeet-core: Settings - audio, screen, privacy, general, profile, integrity (settings.rs)
Screen context is OFF by default and needs
explicit activation. Raw screenshots are not
kept on disk unless store_screenshots is on.
capture_exclusion: ask the OS to exclude the
overlay from screen capture where supported
local_only: refuse to construct any provider
that sends data off the device.
None writes nothing about meetings to disk.
Interviewer mode only, opt-in. signal_enabled(s) is
enabled && (the signal's own flag). candidate_region is the
candidate's video area for gaze; sanitized() clamps its size
to 17..8192 px per side. Off by default: no capture runs.
Interviewer mode: planned_topics, one per line.
